definitions.explanation: The act of planting seedlings, bulbs, or young plants into the ground or a garden bed. A common term in gardening and agriculture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{植|う}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{植|う}え{付|つ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I finished planting the seedlings in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{植|う}え{付|つ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{霜|しも}→霜：03202_shimo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's wait to plant the tomatoes until there's no more risk of frost.

notes:
Noun form of the verb {植|う}え{付|つ}ける (to plant, to transplant). A practical term used by gardeners, farmers, and anyone who grows plants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {植|う}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: planting season/time
- {植|う}え{付|つ}け⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: planting work
- ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{植|う}え{付|つ}け: planting seedlings
- ⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{植|う}え{付|つ}け: planting bulbs

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{種|たね}まき→種まき：08104_tanemaki⟧: sowing seeds (planting seeds directly)
- ⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧: harvest (the end result of planting)
- ⟦{作付|さくづ}け→作付け：23457_sakuzuke⟧: cultivation; crop planting (agricultural/official term)
- ⟦{田植|たう}え→田植え：22734_taue⟧: rice planting (specifically for rice paddies)
